what: Analysis of Variance for Factorial Designs (ANOVA-kun)
title: Analysis of Variance for Factorial Designs (ANOVA-kun)
text: 井関龍太氏による分散分析関数「ANOVA君」(anovakun)を，R パッケージとしてインストールできる形にまとめるためのリポジトリです。 作者：井関龍太(大正大学) 保守：小杉考司(専修大学) 本家：https://riseki.cloudfree.jp/?ANOVA%E5%90%9B 分析の計算そのものは本家の ANOVA君に手を加えず，パッケージの体裁を整えることだけを行います。出力は本家と数値が一致することを確かめてから公開します。

title: Analysis of Variance for Factorial Designs (ANOVA-kun)

title: Analysis of Variance for Factorial Designs (ANOVA-kun)
text: パッケージ版 1.0.0 は本家 4.8.9 を収めています。本家の原本は inst/original/ に置き，本家の関数とパッケージ版が同じデータ・同じ指定で同じ結果を返すことをテスト(tests/testthat/)で確かめています。本家からの変更点(いずれも計算結果には影響しません)は NEWS.md に一覧があります。本家の次の版が公開されたら差し替えます(本家ページを週1回自動で確認し，新版があれば Issue を立てます)。 CRAN への登録を準備中です。

what: Analysis of variance for factorial designs (ANOVA-kun) — anovakun
title: Analysis of variance for factorial designs (ANOVA-kun) — anovakun
text: Performs analysis variance -subjects, within-subjects, mixed designs, given design type number levels factor. Post hoc analyses (multiple comparisons simple effects), sphericity tests corrections, effect sizes confidence intervals included. ANOVA-kun function written Ryuta Iseki, packaged without changing computations.

title: Analysis of variance for factorial designs (ANOVA-kun) — anovakun
text: dataset data frame. -subjects factors arranged columns left (one label column per factor) within-subjects levels across columns (wide format), unless long = TRUE. design character string giving design, e.g. "", "sA", "AsB". Letters s -subjects factors letters within-subjects factors. ... numbers levels factor, given order (e.g. 2, 3). long TRUE, read data long format. type2 TRUE, use Type II sums squares (default Type III). nopost TRUE, run post hoc analyses. tech TRUE, return results list data frames (technical output). data.frame TRUE, also return data frame used computation. copy TRUE, also copy output clipboard. holm TRUE, use Holm's method multiple comparisons. hc = TRUE, Holm-Sidak method used. hc TRUE, use Holland-Copenhaver method multiple comparisons. s2r TRUE, Shaffer's method counts hypotheses actual rejection pattern (Rasmussen's algorithm). s2d TRUE, Shaffer's method counts hypotheses actual rejection pattern (Donoghue's algorithm). fs1 TRUE, use F-Shaffer1 variant (step-1 criterion replaced step-2 criterion). fs2r TRUE, combine Shaffer2 F-Shaffer1 (Rasmussen's algorithm). fs2d TRUE, combine Shaffer2 F-Shaffer1 (Donoghue's algorithm). welch TRUE, use Keselman-Keselman-Shaffer statistic Welch-Satterthwaite degrees freedom multiple comparisons. criteria TRUE, show adjusted significance levels instead adjusted p values multiple comparisons. lb TRUE, adjust degrees freedom within-subjects effects lower bound epsilon. gg TRUE, adjust degrees freedom within-subjects effects Greenhouse-Geisser epsilon. hf TRUE, adjust degrees freedom within-subjects effects Huynh-Feldt epsilon. cm TRUE, adjust degrees freedom within-subjects effects Chi-Muller epsilon. auto TRUE, apply Greenhouse-Geisser adjustment effects whose sphericity test significant. mau TRUE, use Mauchly's test sphericity. har TRUE, use Harris's multisample sphericity test. iga TRUE, use improved general approximation test. ciga TRUE, use corrected improved general approximation test. eta TRUE, add eta squared ANOVA table. peta TRUE, add partial eta squared ANOVA table. geta TRUE, add generalized eta squared. character string factor labels marks factors measured factors. eps TRUE, add epsilon squared ANOVA table. peps TRUE, add partial epsilon squared ANOVA table. geps TRUE, add generalized epsilon squared. character string factor labels marks factors measured factors. omega TRUE, add omega squared (additive model). omegana TRUE, add omega squared (nonadditive model). pomega TRUE, add partial omega squared. gomega TRUE, add generalized omega squared (additive model). character string factor labels marks measured factors. gomegana TRUE, add generalized omega squared (nonadditive model). character string factor labels marks measured factors. prep TRUE, add p_rep ANOVA table. nesci TRUE, compute confidence intervals requested effect sizes based noncentral F distribution. besci TRUE, compute bootstrap confidence intervals requested effect sizes. cilmd TRUE, add difference-adjusted Loftus-Masson confidence intervals descriptive table. cilm TRUE, add Loftus-Masson confidence intervals descriptive table. cind TRUE, add difference-adjusted normalized confidence intervals descriptive table. cin TRUE, add normalized confidence intervals descriptive table. ciml TRUE, add confidence intervals based multilevel model (requires lmerTest pbkrtest packages). cipaird TRUE, output difference-adjusted pairwise confidence intervals. cipair TRUE, output pairwise confidence intervals. bgraph Names confidence-interval options (inner outer, two) drawing bar graph confidence intervals.
